sundai:fc:31.question: 「Aに専念する」の表現はどれ？
sundai:fc:31.fullSentence: He committed himself to finishing the marathon.
sundai:fc:31.explanation: commit oneself to A: Aに専念する。

sundai:fc:32.question: The doctor will _____ the correct medicine for your condition.
sundai:fc:32.fullSentence: The doctor will prescribe the correct medicine for your condition.
sundai:fc:32.explanation: prescribe: 処方する。scribe「書く」語根。

sundai:fc:33.question: 「AをBのせいにする」の表現はどれ？
sundai:fc:33.fullSentence: He ascribed his success to hard work.
sundai:fc:33.explanation: ascribe A to B: AをBのせいにする、帰する。

sundai:fc:34.question: I plan to _____ to this magazine for a whole year.
sundai:fc:34.fullSentence: I plan to subscribe to this magazine for a whole year.
sundai:fc:34.explanation: subscribe (to): 定期購読する、同意する。

sundai:fc:35.question: The old man tends to _____ things down when he takes notes.
sundai:fc:35.fullSentence: The old man tends to scribble things down when he takes notes.

sundai:fc:36.question: 「普及する、優勢である」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:36.fullSentence: This custom still prevails in rural areas.
sundai:fc:36.explanation: prevail: 普及する、優勢である。

sundai:fc:37.hint: 「~を利用する」という意味にする動詞を考えましょう（oneself ofを伴う形）。
sundai:fc:37.question: You should _____ yourself of this rare opportunity.
sundai:fc:37.fullSentence: You should avail yourself of this rare opportunity.

sundai:fc:38.question: Teachers must _____ each student's progress carefully.
sundai:fc:38.fullSentence: Teachers must evaluate each student's progress carefully.
sundai:fc:38.explanation: evaluate: 評価する。valid, valueと同語源。

sundai:fc:39.question: The vase remained _____ even after the earthquake.
sundai:fc:39.fullSentence: The vase remained intact even after the earthquake.
sundai:fc:39.explanation: intact: 無傷の。tact「触れる」語根。

sundai:fc:40.question: 「汚染する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:40.fullSentence: Factories should not contaminate rivers with waste.
sundai:fc:40.explanation: contaminate: 汚染する。contagious(伝染性の)と区別。

sundai:fc:41.question: The flu is highly _____ in winter.
sundai:fc:41.fullSentence: The flu is highly contagious in winter.

sundai:fc:42.question: 「明確な、はっきりとした」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:42.fullSentence: There were no tangible benefits from the project.
sundai:fc:42.explanation: tangible: 明確な、手で触れられるほど確かな。

sundai:fc:43.question: The team changed their _____ in the second half.
sundai:fc:43.fullSentence: The team changed their tactics in the second half.

sundai:fc:44.question: Honesty and _____ are essential in a good leader.
sundai:fc:44.fullSentence: Honesty and integrity are essential in a good leader.

sundai:fc:45.question: 「AをBから切り離す」の表現はどれ？
sundai:fc:45.fullSentence: Please detach this form from the rest of the booklet.
sundai:fc:45.explanation: detach A from B: AをBから切り離す。attach A to B(AをBに付ける)と対で覚える。

sundai:fc:46.question: This small company has a lot of _____ spirit.
sundai:fc:46.fullSentence: This small company has a lot of enterprise spirit.
sundai:fc:46.explanation: enterprise: 企業、進取の気性。prehend/prise「つかむ」語根。

sundai:fc:47.question: 「理解する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:47.fullSentence: I can't comprehend why he did such a thing.

sundai:fc:48.question: This textbook offers a _____ overview of world history.
sundai:fc:48.fullSentence: This textbook offers a comprehensive overview of world history.

sundai:fc:49.question: 「~から構成される」を意味する単語はどれ？

sundai:fc:50.question: The lion chased its _____ across the plain.
sundai:fc:50.fullSentence: The lion chased its prey across the plain.

sundai:fc:51.question: He is famous for being extremely _____; he never changes his mind.
sundai:fc:51.fullSentence: He is famous for being extremely stubborn; he never changes his mind.

sundai:fc:52.question: 「保存する」を意味する単語はどれ？serveの仲間
sundai:fc:52.fullSentence: We need to conserve energy to protect the environment.
sundai:fc:52.explanation: conserve: 保存する。preserve(保存する)、reserve(予約する、蓄える)と区別。

sundai:fc:53.question: You should _____ some food for the winter.
sundai:fc:53.fullSentence: You should preserve some food for the winter.
sundai:fc:53.explanation: preserve: 保存する。preservative(s): 保存料。

sundai:fc:54.question: 「値する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:54.fullSentence: She deserves the award for her hard work.

sundai:fc:55.question: Scientists carefully _____ the behavior of the animals.
sundai:fc:55.fullSentence: Scientists carefully observe the behavior of the animals.
sundai:fc:55.explanation: observe: 観察する。observation: 観察。
